name: unity-compile-on-save
description: Recompile Unity scripts after VS Code saves or Git changes. Wait for the Editor and coalesce changes per project. Requires Unity CLI 1.0.0-beta.11+.

unityCompileOnSave.recompileOnSave.description: Master switch for recompilation triggered by source or project environment changes.

unityCompileOnSave.recompileOnSourceChan.description: Recompile when C# sources, assembly definitions, compiler options, or managed DLLs change. Only effective when Recompile on Save is enabled.

unityCompileOnSave.recompileOnProjectEnv.description: Refresh, resolve packages when needed, and recompile when package or scripting define settings change. Only effective when Recompile on Save is enabled.

unityCompileOnSave.quietPeriodSeconds.description: While recompilation is pending, wait this many seconds after the last change to any file in Assets, Packages, or ProjectSettings. Other files restart the wait without requesting recompilation themselves.

unityCompileOnSave.compileUnityOnSave.description: Legacy master switch; used only if Recompile on Save has not been explicitly configured.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
